paragraphs: Tredegar Corporation is engaged, through its subsidiaries, in the manufacture of aluminum extrusions and polyethylene and polypropylene plastic films. Unless the context requires otherwise, all references herein to "Tredegar," "the Company," "we," "us" or "our" are to Tredegar Corporation and its consolidated subsidiaries.

In the fourth quarter of 2025, the Company renamed the segment formerly known as "PE Films." This segment will be referred to as "High Performance Films" going forward. The product previously known as polyethylene overwrap films was renamed to advanced packaging films. There were no changes to the operations reported within the High Performance Films segment. The Company continues to have two reportable segments: Aluminum Extrusions and High Performance Films.

On November 1, 2024, the Company completed the sale of its flexible packaging films business (also referred to as "Terphane") headquartered in Brazil to Oben Group. All historical results for Terphane have been presented as discontinued operations. For more information on this transaction, see Note 15. "Divestitures" to the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Item 15. "Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules" of this Form 10-K ("Item 15").

Aluminum Extrusions, also referred to as Bonnell Aluminum, produces high-quality, soft and medium strength alloyed aluminum extrusions, custom fabricated and finished, for the building and construction, automotive and transportation, consumer durables goods, machinery and equipment, electrical and renewable energy, and distribution markets. Bonnell Aluminum has manufacturing facilities located in the United States ("U.S.").

Aluminum Extrusions manufactures mill (unfinished), machined, anodized and painted, and thermally improved aluminum extrusions for sale directly to fabricators and distributors. It also manufactures and sells branded product lines: Futura TransitionsTM by Bonnell Aluminum (flooring trims) and TSLOTSTM by Bonnell Aluminum (structural aluminum framing systems). Aluminum Extrusions competes primarily on the basis of product quality, service and price. Sales are made predominantly in the U.S. The end-use markets for Aluminum Extrusions are cyclical and seasonal in nature.
The end-uses in each of Aluminum Extrusions' primary market segments include:

Building & construction ("B&C") - nonresidential Commercial windows and doors, curtain walls, storefronts and entrances, automatic entry doors, walkway covers, ducts, louvers and vents, office wall panels, partitions and interior enclosures, acoustical walls and ceilings, point of purchase displays, pre-engineered structures, and flooring trims (Futura TransitionsTM by Bonnell Aluminum)
B&C - residential Residential windows and doors, shower and tub enclosures, railing and support systems, venetian blinds, and swimming pools

Automotive & transportation Automotive and light truck structural components, battery enclosures for electric vehicles, after-market automotive accessories, grills for heavy trucks, travel trailers and recreation vehicles
Consumer durables Office furniture, pleasure boats, refrigerators and freezers, appliances and sporting goods
Machinery & equipment Material handling equipment, conveyor systems, medical equipment, industrial fans and aluminum framing systems (TSLOTSTM by Bonnell Aluminum)

Distribution (metal service centers specializing in stock and release programs and custom fabrications to small manufacturers) Various custom profiles including storm shutters, pleasure boat accessories, theater set structures and various standard profiles (including rod, bar, tube and pipe)
Electrical & renewable energy Lighting fixtures, electronic apparatus, solar panel brackets and rigid and flexible conduits

paragraphs: There are a number of risks and uncertainties that could have a material adverse effect on the Company's businesses and its consolidated financial condition, results of operations or cash flows. The following risk factors should be considered, in addition to the other information included in this Form 10-K, when evaluating Tredegar and its businesses.

•Trade policies and prolonged geopolitical conflicts could cause an increase in the cost of our products or otherwise negatively impact the Company. The primary raw materials used by Aluminum Extrusions consist of aluminum ingot, aluminum scrap and various alloys, which are purchased from domestic and foreign producers in open-market purchases and under short-term contracts. High Performance Film's Surface Protection business involves imports to and from the U.S. and other countries where the Company produces and sells its products, including China. Trade tensions have been rising between the U.S. and other countries. An increase in tariffs and other trade barriers between the U.S. and other countries could cause disruption to supply chains and an increase in the cost of Aluminum Extrusions' and High Performance Films' products or otherwise negatively impact the production and sale of the Company's products in global markets. Furthermore, prolonged geopolitical conflicts, including recent increased tensions in the Middle East, could result in increased pricing of raw materials and supply chain constraints, which could negatively affect our business, financial position, results of operations and cash flows. Refer to Risks Related to Aluminum Extrusions for additional information about unfairly traded imports of aluminum extrusions.

•Ongoing macroeconomic factors, including inflation, high interest rates and recession risks could cause downturns in key markets and create other commercial disruptions, which could adversely impact our businesses. Products sold to key end-use markets, including the B&C and consumer electronics markets, represent a significant portion of our revenue. Because these markets are tied closely to overall economic performance, macroeconomic factors could cause changes to demand for our products. These factors include: (i) inflation; (ii) high interest rates; (iii) recession risks; and (iv) other interruptions of international and regional commerce. Price erosion may occur as competitors become more aggressive in pricing practices. To the extent that these factors reduce demand for our products, our business, financial position, results of operations and cash flows could be adversely impacted.

•Tredegar's performance is influenced by costs incurred by its operating companies, including the cost of raw materials and energy. These costs include the cost of aluminum (the raw material on which Aluminum Extrusions primarily depends), resin (the raw material on which High Performance Films primarily depends), natural gas (the principal fuel necessary for Aluminum Extrusions' plants to operate), electricity, diesel fuel, chemicals and paint. Aluminum, resin and natural gas prices are volatile as shown in the charts in Item 7A. The Company attempts to mitigate the effects of higher costs, which includes tariff driven cost increases, through price increases and contractual pass-through provisions, but there are no assurances that higher prices can effectively be passed through to customers or that Tredegar will be able to offset fully or on a timely basis the effects of higher costs. Further, the Company's cost control efforts may not be sufficient to offset any increases in raw materials, energy or other input costs.

•Noncompliance with any of the covenants in the Company's $125 million asset-based revolving credit facility ("ABL Facility"), which matures on May 6, 2030, could result in all debt outstanding thereunder becoming due and limiting the Company's borrowing capacity, which could have a material adverse effect on its consolidated financial condition and liquidity. The credit agreement governing Tredegar's ABL Facility contains restrictions and financial covenants that, if violated, could restrict the Company's operational and financial flexibility. Failure to comply with these covenants could result in an event of default, which if not cured or waived, would result in all outstanding debt under the credit facility at such time becoming due, which could have a material adverse effect on the Company's consolidated financial condition and liquidity.

•Our failure to continue to attract, develop and retain certain key officers or employees could adversely affect our businesses. Our success depends upon the efforts and abilities of key personnel, many of whom are longstanding employees. The loss of any of these key personnel could deplete our institutional knowledge base and negatively affect our ability to efficiently operate our businesses. Certain roles have experienced high turnover in recent years, and we are experiencing an increasingly competitive labor market. Increased employee turnover could hinder our ability to execute our business strategy and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

paragraphs: Tredegar Corporation is an industrial manufacturer with two primary businesses: custom aluminum extrusions for the B&C, automotive and specialty end-use markets in the United States through its Aluminum Extrusions segment (with exports comprising less than 5% of total sales volume) and surface protection films for high-end technology applications in the global electronics industry and packaging films for consumer and industrial products through its High Performance Films segment. With approximately 1,700 employees, the Company operates manufacturing facilities in the U.S. and China.

EBITDA from ongoing operations is the measure of segment profit and loss used by Tredegar's chief operating decision maker ("CODM") for purposes of assessing financial performance. The Company uses sales less freight ("net sales") as its measure of revenues from external customers at the segment level. This measure is separately included in the financial information regularly provided to the CODM.

Earnings before interest and taxes ("EBIT") from ongoing operations is a non-GAAP financial measure included in the reconciliation of segment financial information to consolidated results for the Company in the Segment Operations Review section below. EBIT is not intended to represent the stand-alone results for Tredegar's ongoing operations under GAAP and should not be considered as an alternative to net income (loss) as defined by GAAP. We believe that EBIT is a widely understood and utilized metric that is meaningful to certain investors and that including this financial metric in the reconciliation of management's performance metric, EBITDA from ongoing operations, provides useful information to those investors that primarily utilize EBIT to analyze the Company's core operations.

Sales were $722.9 million in 2025 compared to $598.0 million in 2024. Net income (loss) from continuing operations was $24.1 million ($0.69 per diluted share) in 2025, compared with net income (loss) from continuing operations of $1.0 million ($0.03 per diluted share) in 2024.

paragraphs: Tredegar Corporation 透過其子公司從事鋁合金擠壓件及聚乙烯與聚丙烯塑膠薄膜的製造業務。除非上下文另有明確要求，否則本文件中所有提及 "Tredegar"、"the Company"、"we"、"us" 或 "our" 皆指 Tredegar Corporation 及其合併後之子公司。
在 2025 年第四季，本公司將原先稱為 "PE Films" 的應報告分部重新命名。此後，該分部將稱為 "High Performance Films"。原先稱為聚乙烯包裝薄膜的產品已重新命名為先進包裝薄膜。High Performance Films 分部內報告之業務運作並未改變。本公司持續擁有兩個應報告分部：鋁合金擠壓件及 High Performance Films。

2024 年 11 月 1 日，本公司完成出售位於巴西的柔性和包裝薄膜業務（亦稱為 "Terphane"）予 Oben Group。Terphane 之歷史財務結果已列為已終止營運業務。有關此交易之更多資訊，請參閱第 15 註釋 "Divestitures"（出售）至本 10-K 表單所附之財務報表附註（"Item 15"）所列 "Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules"（附屬文件及財務報表附表）。
鋁合金擠壓件，亦稱為 Bonnell Aluminum，製造高品質、軟質及中等強度合金鋁擠壓件，為建築與建設、汽車與運輸、消費性耐用品、機械與設備、電氣與再生能源，以及物流分銷市場提供客製化製造與完工產品。Bonnell Aluminum 在美國（"U.S.") 配置製造廠。
鋁合金擠壓件製造未完工、機加工、陽極氧化、塗裝及熱處理後之鋁擠壓件，直接銷售給製造商與經銷商。其亦製造與銷售自有品牌產品線：Bonnell Aluminum 之 Futura TransitionsTM（地板裝飾條）與 TSLOTSTM（結構性鋁合金框架系統）。鋁合金擠壓件主要以產品品質、服務與價格作為競爭優勢。銷售業務主要發生於美國。鋁合金擠壓件之最終應用市場具有週期性與季節性。
鋁合金擠壓件主要市場分部之最終應用包括：
建築與建設（"B&C"）- 非住宅用途之商業窗戶與門、幕牆、店面與入口、自動門、走道蓋板、風管、百葉窗與通風口、辦公室牆板、隔間與室內包覆、吸音牆與天花板、零售點展示架、預製結構與地板裝飾條（Bonnell Aluminum 之 Futura TransitionsTM）
B&C - 住宅用途 住宅窗戶與門、淋浴與浴缸包覆、欄杆與支撐系統、百葉窗與游泳池
汽車及運輸業 汽車及輕型貨車結構零組件、電動車電池外殼、後市場汽車配件、重型貨車水箱格柵、露營拖車及休閒車
消費性耐用品 辦公傢俱、遊艇、冷凍庫與冷凍箱、家電與運動用品
機械與設備 材料搬運設備、運輸系統、醫療設備、工業風扇及鋁合金框架系統（TSLOTSTM by Bonnell Aluminum）
流通業（金屬服務中心，專門從事庫存與發貨計畫及客製化製造，服務小型製造商） 各種客製化型材，包括風暴百葉窗、遊艇配件、劇場舞臺結構及各種標準型材（包括棒材、條材、管材與鋼管）

paragraphs: Tredegar Corporation 為一間工業製造商，主要業務為：透過其鋁合金擠壓零組件應報告分部，為美國 B&C、汽車及專業應用市場提供客製化鋁合金擠壓零組件（出口佔總銷售額之比例低於 5%），以及透過其高性能薄膜應報告分部，為全球電子產業之高階科技應用提供表面保護薄膜，並為消費性及工業產品提供包裝薄膜。本公司約有 1,700 名員工，營運美國及中國之製造廠房。
EBITDA 從持續性營運中取得，為 Tredegar 之主要營運決策者（"CODM"）評估財務表現所使用之應報告分部獲利與虧損衡量指標。本公司於應報告分部層級，以銷售額減運費（"淨銷售額"）作為對外部客戶之營業收入衡量指標。此衡量指標於定期提供給 CODM 之財務資訊中單獨列示。

營業收入（"EBIT"）從持續性營運中取得，為一非 GAAP 財務指標，包含於應報告分部財務資訊與本公司合併財務結果之對應表中，於下文之應報告分部營運審閱部分。EBIT 不代表 Tredegar 持續性營運在 GAAP 下之獨立財務表現，亦不應被視為 GAAP 所定義之淨收入（虧損）之替代指標。本公司認為 EBIT 為一廣為理解與應用之指標，對部分投資者而言具重要性，並包含此財務指標於管理績效指標 EBITDA 從持續性營運中取得之對應表中，為主要使用 EBIT 分析本公司核心營運之投資者提供有用資訊。
2025 年銷售額為 722.9 百萬美元，較 2024 年之 598.0 百萬美元為高。2025 年持續性營運之淨收入（虧損）為 24.1 百萬美元（每股稀釋後 0.69 美元），較 2024 年持續性營運之淨收入（虧損） 1.0 百萬美元（每股稀釋後 0.03 美元）為高。

paragraphs: 本公司業務及合併財務狀況、營業成果或現金流可能受到多項風險與不確定性因素的重大影響。評估 Tredegar 及其業務時，除本 Form 10-K 所包含的其他資訊外，應同時考量下列風險因素。

•貿易政策與持續的國際政治衝突可能導致本公司產品成本增加，或對本公司造成其他負面影響。鋁合金擠壓業務所使用的主要原料為鋁錠、鋁廢料及各種合金，這些原料透過公開市場買賣及短期契約向國內外生產商購入。高性能薄膜的表面保護業務涉及與美國及其他國家之間的進出口，包括中國。美國與其他國家之間的貿易緊張關係持續升高。美國與其他國家之間關稅及其他貿易壁壘的增加，可能導致供應鏈中斷，並提高鋁合金擠壓業務與高性能薄膜業務產品的成本，或對本公司產品在全球市場的生產與銷售造成其他負面影響。此外，持續的國際政治衝突，包括近期中東地區的緊張局勢，可能導致原材料價格上漲與供應鏈限制，這可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況、營業成果與現金流造成負面影響。請參閱與鋁合金擠壓相關的風險以取得有關不公平貿易進口鋁合金擠壓產品的更多資訊。

•持續的總體經濟因素，包括通貨膨脹、高利率與經濟衰退風險，可能導致關鍵市場出現衰退，並造成其他商業中斷，這可能會對本公司業務造成不利影響。銷售至關鍵終端市場，包括B&C與消費電子市場的產品，佔本公司營業收入的很大一部分。由於這些市場與總體經濟表現緊密相關，總體經濟因素可能導致對本公司產品的需求發生變化。這些因素包括：(i) 通貨膨脹；(ii) 高利率；(iii) 經濟衰退風險；以及(iv) 其他國際與區域商業活動的中斷。競爭對手若更積極地採用價格策略，可能會導致價格下跌。若這些因素導致對本公司產品的需求減少，則本公司業務、財務狀況、營業成果與現金流可能會受到不利影響。

•Tredegar 的營運表現受其營運公司所產生的成本影響，包括原材料與能源成本。這些成本包含鋁（Aluminum Extrusions 主要依賴的原材料）、樹脂（High Performance Films 主要依賴的原材料）、天然氣（Aluminum Extrusions 工廠運作所需的主要燃料）、電力、柴油、化學品與塗料成本。鋁、樹脂與天然氣價格波動性高，如 Item 7A 中的圖表所示。本公司試圖透過價格調漲與契約條款中的成本轉嫁機制來緩解成本上升的影響，但無法確保能有效將較高的價格轉嫁給客戶，或 Tredegar 能夠在合適的時間點完全抵銷成本上升的影響。此外，本公司成本控制措施可能不足以抵銷原材料、能源或其他投入成本的任何上升。

•未遵守本公司 $125 百萬資產抵押循環信貸融資（"ABL Facility"）中任何契約條款，且該信貸融資到期日為 2030 年 5 月 6 日，可能會導致該信貸融資下所有債務立即到期，並限制本公司借款能力，這可能會對其合併財務狀況與流動性產生重大不利影響。管理 Tredegar ABL 融資的信貸協議包含限制條款與財務契約條款，若違反這些條款，可能會限制本公司營運與財務的靈活性。未能遵守這些契約條款可能會導致發生違約事件，若未解決或未豁免，則該信貸融資下所有未償還債務將立即到期，這可能會對本公司合併財務狀況與流動性產生重大不利影響。
